# Production Checklist: Production-Ready Boilerplate

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements-quality of the production-ready boilerplate spec (accounts/roles, command palette, i18n, GDPR compliance, deployment) - completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of what is WRITTEN in the spec, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the GDPR compliance document templates (records of processing, breach response, DPA checklist) specified with concrete deliverable form and where they live? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard operation, ARIA labels) specified for the command palette, language switcher, consent banner, and age-gate checkbox? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the retention/purge requirement quantified (grace period length, definition of "dormant account")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the security-notification requirement complete for all listed events (password change, 2FA enable/disable, account deletion) with recipient and failure behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the audit-log requirement specified beyond who/what/when (target, outcome, retention of the log itself)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is "immediately" quantified for language switching (explicit time bound or "no full reload" only)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the browser-locale detection rule unambiguous for unsupported locales? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the data-export "readable file" specified with format expectations (structure, redaction, size limits)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are the two consent choices defined in terms of which cookies/storage each one permits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the age-gate requirement clear about placement, the exact confirmation text, and what blocks registration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Do the two-choice consent requirements (FR-014/FR-015) conflict with the existing per-category cookie preferences dialog in the current boilerplate? [Conflict]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are language requirements consistent between User Story 3 (signed-in switcher) and FR-010/FR-011 (visitors without a preference)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does the deployment requirement (FR-027) align with the success criteria and the README assumptions about hosting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK014 - Do the GDPR user-story acceptance scenarios cover the same scope as FR-016 to FR-018? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 - Are SC-001 through SC-008 measurable and verifiable without implementation knowledge? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001..SC-008]
- [ ] CHK016 - Can the "production-ready" claim be objectively verified from the stated success criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Are exception flows defined for email-provider failure in security notifications (provider not configured)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are alternate scenarios covered for the command palette when signed out? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are recovery flows defined for a failed retention purge run? [Gap, Recovery Flow]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the i18n-disabled path (single language only) covered as a valid configuration? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are edge cases defined for duplicate emails, last-admin protection, and OAuth-only account deletion? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the consent-choice-change scenario (user reopens cookie settings later) specified? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the missing-translation fallback verified for every UI surface (pages, forms, dialogs, emails)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 - Are performance targets specified for language switching and command palette responsiveness? [Gap, NFR]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation, focus management, screen-reader labels) defined for the palette and switcher? [Coverage, NFR]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are security requirements defined for audit-log integrity (append-only, tamper-evidence)? [Gap, NFR]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are observability requirements defined (logging for purge runs, notification failures, consent decisions)? [Gap, NFR]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 - Are external dependencies (email provider, OAuth providers) documented with failure modes and dev fallbacks? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are the assumed retention defaults (session grace period, dormant-account opt-in) validated or flagged for consumer decision? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the test-framework assumption (vitest + RTL) stated as a decision rather than an open question? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 - Is the term "critical flows" in FR-023 defined with an explicit list of flows? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK032 - Does the spec resolve how the existing command palette relates to the required palette behavior (rebuild vs. harden)? [Conflict/Ambiguity, Spec §US2]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
